data.note: Arrived in St. John's c.1825-1830, reportedly as a young stowaway cabin-boy; taken in by John Hoskins and settled around Trinity Bay.
Of Lower Island Cove. Married William Cooper Dec 6, 1841.
Believed to have died young — no record of marriage or children found.
